instructions: Human elicitation guide (spec §21 item 7): each row whose u is the TBD literal needs a human-supplied standard uncertainty u(x) plus provenance before any combined uncertainty may be emitted — the loader fails closed (no u_c) while any row is TBD. Qualifying evidence per row: chronograph datasheet (velocity; give model, serial, calibration date); sensor datasheets/certs (pressure, temperature, humidity, wind-station meters); optic-height and range tolerances from the instrument spec; BC scatter from supplier sheets or firing records; wind-aloft vs station error from measurement campaigns. Where no measurement exists, a labeled engineering judgment is acceptable ONLY if recorded as judgment (author, date, rationale, and the distribution choice it supports) — judgment must never be silently treated as measured data. Distributions shown are TEMPLATE DEFAULTS per spec §12.1 (normal for sensors, uniform where only bounds are known): the human must confirm or replace each one. Correlation stays 'assumed-independent — see risk' until a measurement campaign justifies covariances (pressure/temperature/altitude triples, band BCs, multi-station profiles). Nonlinear-flagged rows route to Monte Carlo (Phase 5), never into the linear combiner. Approval: a human reviewer approves this template and the sources of the first completed budget (§21 item 7); silently filling a numeric u without review must fail the all-TBD test.
